# Shader bytecode embedding (P1, ADR-003).
#
# triangle.hlsl is the single source of truth. The DXIL/SPIR-V bytecode in
# generated/ is a committed build artifact (generated by tools/ci/compile_shaders.ps1),
# consumed verbatim at build time. The build never invokes a shader compiler, so
# macOS (no dxc distribution) builds unchanged.

set(SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated")
set(SHADERS_HEADER_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
set(SHADERS_HEADER "${SHADERS_HEADER_DIR}/shaders_generated.hpp")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${SHADERS_HEADER}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${SHADERS_HEADER_DIR}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
            "-DINPUTS=${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_vs.dxil;${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_ps.dxil;${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_vs.spv;${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_ps.spv;${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_vs.dxil;${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_ps.dxil;${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_vs.spv;${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_ps.spv"
            "-DSYMBOLS=kTriangleVsDxil;kTrianglePsDxil;kTriangleVsSpv;kTrianglePsSpv;kCameraVsDxil;kCameraPsDxil;kCameraVsSpv;kCameraPsSpv"
            "-DOUTPUT=${SHADERS_HEADER}"
            "-DNAMESPACE=jrpgmaker::shaders"
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/cmake/bin_to_cpp.cmake"
    DEPENDS
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_vs.dxil"
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_ps.dxil"
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_vs.spv"
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/triangle_ps.spv"
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_vs.dxil"
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_ps.dxil"
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_vs.spv"
        "${SHADERS_GENERATED_DIR}/camera_ps.spv"
    VERBATIM)

add_custom_target(jrpgmaker_shaders_generate DEPENDS "${SHADERS_HEADER}")

add_library(jrpgmaker_shaders INTERFACE)
add_library(jrpgmaker::shaders ALIAS jrpgmaker_shaders)
add_dependencies(jrpgmaker_shaders jrpgmaker_shaders_generate)
target_include_directories(jrpgmaker_shaders INTERFACE "${SHADERS_HEADER_DIR}")
